subject: Signatory roles & PO-ack flow for Ariba/Coupa onboarding
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@healthtechsys.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement-team@healthtechsys.com
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify signatory roles + PO ack requirements for Redwood MSA/Order Form

Jonas — thanks for the demo yesterday. Two quick items the procurement team needs clarified before we can finish our supplier registration in Ariba/Coupa:

1) Who must sign the MSA and Order Form for HealthTech to complete our legal intake? We have different signer tiers (Legal signer vs Finance signer) and need to know which is acceptable.
2) For PO acknowledgement: does Redwood require electronic PO acknowledgement through Ariba, or will a PO PDF + emailed confirmation suffice? Our ERP enforces an ACK window and we need to confirm behavior.

Can you loop in legal and ops so we have a single record with the right signers?

Thanks,
Sara Nguyen
Senior Procurement Manager
HealthTech Systems
[Attachment: HealthTech_Signer_Matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@healthtechsys.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify signatory roles + PO ack requirements for Redwood MSA/Order Form

Hi Sara — looping in our legal and ops leads (Mateo + Marissa). Quick answers up front:

- MSA: our standard playbook requires an authorized signatory with legal execution authority. For Enterprise deals we typically accept either an "Authorized Officer" signature from the customer (legal sign-off) or a delegated Finance signatory when accompanied by a PO and explicit delegation evidence.
- Order Form / PO ACK: Redwood's preferred path for portal onboarding is an electronic PO acknowledgement in Ariba/Coupa (ACK) because it ties into our routing for invoicing and SLA tracking. That said, we can accept PDF + emailed confirmation as an interim method for activation if you provide the ERP ACK window details and a named contact for invoice routing.

Mateo — can you confirm whether we need any MSA clause edits to accept a finance-only signer for this account? Marissa — ops: if HealthTech chooses PDF + email for initial activation, what's the manual step and SLA impact?

Next: if you can send the signer matrix (looks attached) and your ERP ACK window, we can propose an activation path and a minimal redline if needed.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Partnerships — Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0147
[Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@healthtechsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify signatory roles + PO ack requirements for Redwood MSA/Order Form

Thanks for the context. A couple of legal notes for clarity:

- We prefer the counterparty's legal signatory (CEO/CLO/CFO-level depending on org) on the MSA. If HealthTech can only route signing through Finance, we'll need:
  * A written delegation/boarding email from an authorized officer confirming the delegation; and
  * Confirmation that the Order Form's price/term won't be amended after Finance signs.

- On the Order Form vs PO: we treat signed Order Forms as contract amendments (preferred). If you submit a PO only, we rely on the PO language to incorporate the MSA — which can be fragile across procurement systems. To avoid ambiguity, if HealthTech will use PO-only activation, we request an explicit PO clause that references the MSA by version/date.

I reviewed the attached HealthTech_Signer_Matrix.xlsx and noted a couple of gaps (row 4: delegation doc missing; row 7: signer title ambiguous). I've attached a short redline (MSA_redline_v3.pdf) that adds a Delegation Acceptance clause and clarifies Order Form vs PO precedence. Please review with your legal/procurement.

[Attachment: MSA_redline_v3.pdf (pdf)]

If HealthTech prefers not to change our MSA, the path that usually works is: legal signatory signs MSA + Finance issues PO in Ariba (ACK) — that gives ops the cleanest routing.

Happy to hop on a 15-min call to walk through the redline.

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Counsel, Contracting — Redwood Inference

From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@healthtechsys.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement-team@healthtechsys.com
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 15:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify signatory roles + PO ack requirements for Redwood MSA/Order Form

Matt (cc'd as procurement lead) and I reviewed Mateo's redline. Quick responses:

- We can provide the delegation email from our General Counsel authorizing Finance to sign the MSA for transactions under $1M. I attached a completed signer matrix and flagged the delegation doc that will be issued this afternoon.
- Our ERP ACK window is 72 hours for PO acceptance; we can support an Ariba electronic ACK as part of the activation workflow.

Attached: HealthTech_Signer_Matrix.xlsx (completed), delegation_email_stub.pdf (will be uploaded later).

If the delegation email + completed matrix satisfy the legal edits in MSA_redline_v3.pdf, we can proceed with Finance signing the MSA and then issue PO in Ariba for the initial reserved capacity.

Thanks — Sara
[Attachment: HealthTech_Signer_Matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@healthtechsys.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify signatory roles + PO ack requirements for Redwood MSA/Order Form

Thanks, Sara — this is great and clears the path. Summary & next steps so we all have a single source of truth:

1) HealthTech will provide the GC delegation email confirming Finance authority for MSA signing (under $1M). Please upload to the Ariba supplier record and share a link or drop in the Drive folder.
2) HealthTech_Signer_Matrix.xlsx received and matches our expectations.
3) Mateo's redline is acceptable if the delegation email is uploaded. Legal will generate an execution-ready MSA and send to Finance for signature.
4) Activation via portal: please issue the initial PO in Ariba and confirm electronic ACK (72-hour window). If ACK does not arrive within the window, Ops (Marissa) will process a manual activation using the emailed PDF + confirmation. Manual activation SLA: +2 business days.

Attachments (for internal tracking): Signed_OrderForm_stub.pdf (placeholder that ops will replace once signed).

I'll schedule a 15-min sync for Monday to confirm upload and sign-off. If anything changes, reply-all and we'll triage.

Best — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Partnerships — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Signed_OrderForm_stub.pdf (pdf)]
